insights.title: Context grew from 29.2k to 118.5k tokens
insights.detail: The median context of the last three model calls (118.5k) is over 2× the median of the first three (29.2k); ~15.5M cumulative excess input-class tokens were re-paid beyond the opening baseline, at the rates those calls actually paid (cache reads where the context was served from cache). The estimate is an upper bound: it assumes the work could have continued from a compacted context. The largest tool outputs listed in evidence are the likely culprits.
insights.suggestion: Run /compact at a natural checkpoint, or start a fresh session for the next task — the context grown since the start was re-paid on every later call, ~15.5M tokens in total.
